rationale: The workflow already implements several evidence-supported optimizations: concurrency control (P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE), dependency caching for Composer (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE), and matrix strategy with implicit fail-fast (P-LIT-FAIL-FAST default). The remaining patterns from the catalogue either lack prerequisite evidence (P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT requires representative successful-duration history, but recent runs are all failures), have contraindications for this linting workflow (P-LIT-FAIL-FAST explicit opt-in conflicts with 'every matrix outcome is required' for multi-version PHP linting), or require CI-service-level changes not expressible in workflow YAML (P-LIT-FAILED-JOB-FIRST, P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE). No supported, safe, minimal change meets the evidence threshold.
